Ships referred to as '''Republic battlecruisers''' by [[Aleema Keto]] participated in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] blockading [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising|Naddist Revolt]] in [[3998 BBY]].<ref name="TOTJa" /><ref name="TOTJ:TFNU" /> Another, more general term for them was '''Republic military ships'''.<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>

==Characteristics==
Though varying in appearance, some of the more prominent vessels in the blockade were marked by elongated hulls, raised command towers and extended flaps connected to the main hull near the stern. The ships were less massive than the [[Republic battleship (Great Sith War)|battleships]] used by the peacekeeping forces later in the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].<ref name="TOTJ:TFNU" />

==History==
When [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] requested assistance during the [[Second Battle of Onderon]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent a [[War Fleet of the Republic]] to aide his force against the [[Naddist]]s.<ref name="TOTJ:TFNU" />

[[File:War_fleet2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The ''[[Krath Enchanter]]'' evades the Republic blockade.]]

The [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] leaders, [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal]] and [[Aleema Keto]] encountered the War Fleet as they tried to gain access to Onderon. They managed to evade the battlecruisers and dove for the surface, even after being warned off by [[Wing 3]].<ref name="TOTJa" />
